headline: Narrator, from entry to detail
overview: Narrator is an AI-powered storytelling experience where your personal growth journey is woven into an evolving narrative. The AI draws on your reflections, assessments, and milestones to craft a story about you — helping you see your life from a narrative perspective and discover themes, arcs, and meaning that may not be obvious when you're living it day by day.
targetAudience: Users interested in spirituality tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: AI-powered narrative that weaves your growth journey into a personal story
Story chapters generated from your reflections, assessments, and milestones
Theme and arc identification across your personal growth data
Evolving narrative that updates as you continue your journey
tips: The more data you have across other modules, the richer and more personalized your narrative will be
Read your narrative periodically to gain perspective on how your story is evolving
